PR: fix: Only set discard logger if debug is false [closed]
### Description of your changes

It seems like calling `ctrl.SetLogger` twice isn't working properly. When running with the `--debug` flag no controller-runtime logs are actually printed.

You should be able to reproduce this by adding a panic in a reconciler and see that the stack trace is never logged.
